titulo: Majority of people who have been in US prisons were also victims of violent crime, study finds
cuerpo: Report based on survey of 20,000 Americans says 84% of people who are incarcerated were assaulted, shot or stabbed The majority of people who have spent time in a US prison or jail have, at one point in their lives, been a victim of a violent crime, according to a new study. Researchers with Just Safe, a victims’ advocacy non-profit, found that 84% of people who had been incarcerated reported being assaulted, shot or stabbed before their first time in jail or prison. The report is based on a nationally representative survey of 20,000 Americans. Of those who have been incarcerated, half of them had been hurt by a caregiver as a child and one-third were victims of sexual or intimate partner violence. Continue reading...
